title: Codex CLI v0.150.0: task @ mentions, Interrupt hooks, permission-mode shortcuts
description: Codex CLI 0.150.0 lets you reference other Codex tasks with @ mentions and manage them from the terminal, adds an Interrupt hook that fires commands or MCP handlers when a turn is cut short, plus a /copy picker, auto-generated task titles with /rename suggestions, clickable markdown links, and shortcut/Vim improvements. Security fixes stop untrusted projects from injecting project-level AGENTS.md instructions and improve credential redaction in app-server logs.

community_feedback.quote: Codex is rapidly degrading — please take this seriously... tasks hang or fail in roughly two-thirds of cases.

title: Gemini CLI v0.57.0: capacity-error retries, cancel rollback, and macOS Seatbelt sandbox isolation
description: Stable release adding silent retries with TTL for capacity errors, rollback of multi-turn requests on cancel, git environment normalization, Cloud Workstations OAuth proxy redirect and IDE connection directory-mismatch fixes, preservation of empty text turns containing tools/media, and roughly a dozen SSR Agent fixes (TUI timeouts, sub-agent token regression, autocomplete). Preview builds further isolate Docker/container runtime sockets in the macOS Seatbelt sandbox.

title: `codex mcp-server` deprecated in favor of the Codex app server
description: OpenAI deprecated the `codex mcp-server` subcommand, replacing it with the Codex app server; Claude Code users are directed to the Codex plugin for Claude Code as the supported integration path.

community_feedback.quote: OpenAI is consolidating deep Codex integrations around App Server. mcp-server is no longer the recommended starting point.

title: Weekly update (Week 34): /design research preview, Concise output style, ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL
description: Claude Code shipped v2.1.234–v2.1.239 including a /design research preview for UI drafting/editing via artifacts in CLI and Desktop, a built-in 'Concise' output style that leads with results, claude remote-control machines shown as phone device cards, and a new ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL env var to set the default model for new sessions.

title: The new GitHub Copilot experience in Slack
description: GitHub launched a refreshed Copilot experience in Slack in public preview for Copilot Business and Enterprise organizations. Copilot can be assigned coding tasks from Slack conversations and drive them to pull requests, bringing agentic coding help directly into team chat.

community_feedback.quote: this is exactly why we're seeing teams move toward 'bounded' agents.

title: Shared agentic work with GitHub Copilot in Microsoft Teams
description: GitHub introduced team-based agentic workflows for Copilot in Microsoft Teams, letting teammates share agent sessions and collaborate on agentic coding tasks together inside Teams.

title: Devin Desktop v3.8.20: Agent Command Center revamp, multi-root workspaces, live shell streaming
description: The Agent Command Center now tracks whole spaces instead of a single folder, converts editor windows to agents in place, and runs multiple agent windows side by side; Ctrl/Cmd+G switches Agent/Editor modes. Devin Local adds multi-root workspaces with virtual folders, Markdown plan files with an explicit Implement button, and mid-turn subagent stopping; Devin Cloud adds live shell output streaming and session URL copying. (Windsurf IDE was rebranded Devin Desktop under Cognition in June 2026.)

title: Cloud Agents and Cursor Harness Improvements: Subscriptions, Custom Modes, isolated subagents, /goal
description: Cursor cloud agents can now auto-wake on events via Subscriptions (monitor PRs, watch Slack threads, run scheduled tasks), hold long-lived objectives with /goal, use any skill as an 'always on' Custom Mode, and run subagents on their own isolated VMs. Follow-ups can also steer a working agent without interrupting it.

title: Origin Code Hosting launches in early beta
description: Cursor launched Origin, its own code hosting service, in early beta across all paid plans: hosted repos, pull requests with two-way GitHub sync, agents embedded in every repo, and app integrations with Vercel, Depot, and Buildkite. The broad rollout landed the same week as a multi-hour GitHub outage, amplifying attention.

community_feedback.quote: As a customer I'm stoked and looking forward to fully switching over as that's exactly what I want.
Please make it Fediverse/Forgejo/etc compatible. It is 2026 and I'm so tired of silos.
I do wonder if calling this 'Origin' is going to result in semantic misinterpretations by LLMs.
Cursor is launching a GitHub competitor. Is this a land grab?
a good way to avoid GitHub downtime
there was no mention of privacy policy or how stored code gets used.
Origin, our code hosting platform, is now live. It's fast, easy to use, and deeply integrated with Cursor.

title: Grok 4.6 is now available in GitHub Copilot
description: xAI's Grok 4.6 model landed in GitHub Copilot's model picker across surfaces including VS Code, Visual Studio, Copilot CLI, and the cloud agent, priced at $2/M input and $6/M output tokens.

title: Auto mode becomes the default permission mode for new sessions on Pro, Max, and Team plans
description: Starting August 14, 2026, Claude Code's 'auto mode' became the default permission mode for new sessions on Pro, Max, and Team plans unless users have set their own default mode. Auto mode uses a classifier to review Bash commands instead of prompting for every action; explicit permission rules still fire before the classifier.

community_feedback.quote: If you're relying on a prompt to constrain agent behavior, you've already lost.
it's a good default because you really do get prompted incessantly without it.
Auto mode has been a total game-changer and become core to how I work with Claude.

title: Cloud Agents start 3x faster with Builds
description: Cursor introduced Builds — ready-to-use copies of your development environment that cloud agents boot into instead of setting up from scratch. Internally reported as 10x faster environment boot and 3x faster time-to-first-token; broken builds never become active so agent runs stay resilient. Included at no extra cost.

title: Gemini 3.7 Flash is now available in GitHub Copilot
description: Google's Gemini 3.7 Flash was added as a selectable model in GitHub Copilot, expanding the multi-model roster available to Copilot users.

title: Devin Desktop v3.7.25: faster sidebar at scale and MCP auth fixes
description: Sidebar filtering, grouping, and sorting now only process fetched sessions, removing multi-second lag with large session caches. Devin Local also fixed authentication failures with certain MCP servers such as self-hosted GitLab and older Atlassian instances.

title: Gemini 3.7 Flash is now available in Devin
description: Gemini 3.7 Flash went live in Devin Desktop and Devin CLI, which Cognition says reaches Claude Sonnet 5-level performance at less than half the cost. Available at a 50% discount for two weeks after launch.
